findings.description: The retry now uses the most recent answered question from any earlier turn, even when the immediately previous turn was an abstention. The removed docstring explicitly said a follow-up after an abstention should not get the retry.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the user asks Q1 (answered), then Q2 about something out of scope (abstained), then a weak follow-up such as 'tell me more about that' that refers back. The old code required the previous turn to be answered, so no retry happened. The new code finds Q1 in the list and glues it to the follow-up, so retrieval uses Q1's topic. The model then answers from context unrelated to the follow-up, which is the outcome the removed docstring warned against.
